answer: Unique Work Replay Ledger. Each agent must periodically submit a signed trace of solved tasks; duplicates of the same trace are rejected, and independent workers certify novelty. A zephyr of random spot-checks forces live recomputation. Forging N identities requires N distinct task histories plus certification pigment that decays if copied. Any reused trace leaves a velvet audit trail linking clones, so attackers pay full compute cost per identity, not one shared cost.
